No, that is not true. While the **regular full AHV pension** is indeed paid from the age of 65 for both men and women in Switzerland, you **can** choose to receive it **early**, but this comes with a reduction in the monthly pension amount.

You can begin receiving your AHV pension as early as **age 63**, but if you do so, your pension will be reduced for each month before the official retirement age of 65. Conversely, you can also defer receiving your pension beyond age 65, in which case the monthly amount increases for each deferred month.

The decision to take early or deferred retirement is a personal choice, but it significantly impacts the total amount you receive over your lifetime.
